name: add-metrics
program:
let noise : Int -> Int =
  fun i -> int_mod(i * 7919 + 104729, 10007)
in
let readings : [(Int, Int, Int)] =
  init(300, fun i ->
    (int_mod(noise(i), 4),
     int_mod(noise(i + 1), 50) + 1,
     int_mod(noise(i + 2), 20) + 5))
in
let station : (Int, Int, Int) -> Int =
  fun (s, _, _) -> s
in
let volume : (Int, Int, Int) -> Int =
  fun (_, v, _) -> v
in
let cost : (Int, Int, Int) -> Int =
  fun (_, _, c) -> c
in
let from_station : Int -> [(Int, Int, Int)] =
  fun s -> filter(readings, fun r -> station(r) == s)
in
let billed : [(Int, Int, Int)] -> [Int] =
  fun rows -> map(rows, fun r -> volume(r) * cost(r))
in
let subtotal : [Int] -> Int =
  fun amounts -> fold_left(amounts, fun (acc, n) -> acc + n, 0)
in
let target = from_station(2) in
let total = subtotal(billed(target)) in
total

steps.label: insert_before
actions: (Structural(Insert Before total"let peak : Int =\n  fold_left(billed(target), fun (acc, n) -> if n > acc then n else acc, 0)\nin"))

steps.label: insert_before
actions: (Structural(Insert Before total"let busy : Int =\n  length(filter(target, fun r -> volume(r) > 25))\nin"))

actions:
(Structural(Insert Before total"let mean_cost : Int =
  let total_cost = fold_left(map(target, cost), fun (acc, n) -> acc + n, 0) in
  total_cost / length(target)
in"))
